headline: Rejected House resolution would have directed the President to remove U.S. troops from Syria within 180 days.
what_it_does: This resolution would have used the War Powers Resolution to direct the President to pull U.S. Armed Forces out of Syria. The troops would have had to be removed within 180 days after the resolution was adopted. The House voted it down on March 8, 2023.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. service members stationed in Syria
who_it_affects.how: They would have been withdrawn from Syria within 180 days.
They would have been directed to end the U.S. military presence in Syria by the deadline.
